title: Finite purely inseparable base change of a formally smooth adic local algebra is regular
statement: Let k be a field and C a Noetherian local k-algebra formally smooth for its maximal-ideal-adic topology. For every finite purely inseparable field extension k' / k, the ring k' tensor_k C is regular.

source.place: More on Algebra, Theorem Tag 07EL, implication (2) => (1), proof lines 9894--9907

proof.text: Base change formal smoothness to the tensor product, upgrade from the extended maximal ideal to the unique maximal ideal using ideal containment and the square-zero lifting criterion, then apply Tag 07EI and localize at primes. Transport regularity across the canonical tensor-factor swap.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 07EL (theorem-regular-fs), 07EG (lemma-base-change-fs), and 07EI (lemma-fs-implies-regular). Kept the statement and its dependencies. Reused the existing purely inseparable base-change locality node, adic base-change node, regular-local localization node, and tensor-product public universal property. Wrote the needed topology change directly as a square-zero lifting argument from I contained in the new maximal ideal; no cofinality claim is assumed. Created only the strictly smaller 07EI regular-local helper, with three kinds of Mathlib search and no proof. The argument handles both characteristics and the degree-one extension.
